row.notes: 5-byte jmp thunk into .data1 body 0x14f44ad60, bound through its only call at 0x142ea0fe4 (TyreComponent init 0x142ea08f0). Looks up tyres.compound_classes by the label in name (the car's 'compound class' entity attribute, read by 0x142a90fe0; '<name>_sprint' when check_weekend_format is set and the session flag +0x244 is 1) and returns *(classes+0xf0) + stat_id*0x1f0. The caller stores the class at the tyre component's +0x9bc0 and then builds three tyre models (0x142e839a0, visual compound at model+0x60) per entry of the class's visual list +0x170 ({visual compound, physical mask}, 0x10 apart), so the class must be chosen here, before the models exist.

verify.notes: V1001 0x142e97cb0 is jmp 0x14f44ad60 (body 0x14f44ad60-0x14f44afe2). A rel32 scan of .xtls/.data1 finds one call of the thunk (0x142ea0fe4 in 0x142ea08f0) and one ref to the body (the thunk); the only other .data1 hit, jns at 0x14a03ee5c, sits behind an opaque predicate (and ecx,edi gives 0x9494c92d, SF=1, so cmovns never selects it). Body: label lookup in tyres.compound_classes / CompoundClass via Gdb_Find_RowByLabel, stat_id via Gdb_Get_FieldInt read as a byte (movzx [val+8]), returns stat_id*0x1f0 + *(rcx+0xf0). With r8b set it formats '%s_%s' (0x1456708d0) with name and 'sprint' (0x1457ef8f0) into a 256-byte buffer and looks that label up instead. Caller 0x142ea08f0 reads the bool attribute 'check weekend format' into +0x9bb8 and the 16-byte 'compound class' attribute through 0x142a90fe0, passes rcx=[0x146080790], rdx=&value, r8d=movzx +0x9bb8, stores rax at +0x9bc0, then walks +0x170..+0x178 (stride 0x10) calling 0x142e839a0 at +0x30+n*0xde0 +0/+0x4a0/+0x940 with entry qword 0; 0x142e839a0 (jmp 0x14f3c25a0) stores it at model+0x60. Builder 0x142e9a7d0 (called with obj+0xe8, so begin = obj+0xf0) pushes {visual compound ptr (idx*0x58 + visual array), physical bitmask} into class+0x170. Proto arity and types match (name is used as a char* by %s and the FNV label). Details the notes leave out: the sprint path also requires *(*(classes+0x78)+0x88) and its +0x260 entity to be non-null and that entity not to be (or derive from) type 0x146129ca0 (the shared bail-out idiom, also in 0x1400fb8e0); the +0x244 byte is on the object returned by vcall +0x90 on entity+0x1030; a missing row or field gives index 0, so the result is never NULL and a missing '<name>_sprint' row does not fall back to the plain label. Naming nit: PROTOCOL 3 wants _Thunk on .data1 thunks (KB is mixed). sigcheck (--exe f1-modding/work/exe/F1_25.exe): one hit, match 0x142ea0fe4, target 0x142e97cb0
